newsitem.title: USA: Global Pharmaceutical sees '97 production approval.
newsitem.headline: Global Pharmaceutical sees '97 production approval.

text.p: Global Pharmaceutical Corp on Monday said it hoped the U.S. Food and Drug Administration would complete an inspection by early 1997 that would allow the company to begin production.

The company said it met with senior FDA officials as part of effort to start manufacturing at its renovated facilities. Global Pharmaceuticals said it would provide the FDA with additional information in December, then the government agency would start the last phase of its investigation.
